hypotheses.justification: The same file proves the statement without `htwo`. In the `NoTwo` section, `chartHom_surjOn_fixedSubring_noTwo` (line 1037) takes only `[IsPrecomplete (Ideal.span {π}) W]`, `hreg` and `hsep` and concludes `∀ x ∈ fixedSubring π, x ∈ Set.range (chartHom π)`. Its proof goes through `exists_uvSwapEquiv_fixed_lift_noTwo`. There, `htwo` was only used to show that the diagonal coefficients of the antisymmetric `g` vanish (`coeff_diag_eq_zero_of_anti`). That step is replaced by `coeff_diag_eq_zero_of_hreg` (line 952), which derives the same fact from `hreg` alone: `diagPart g * (X0*X1 - C π) = 0`, and then `hreg` applies. None of these lemmas depends on `fixedSubring_le_range_chartHom`. They use only earlier results (`coeff_mul_crossing`, `coeff_uvSwapEquiv`, `lowerPart_sub_uvSwapEquiv`, `mk_mem_range_chartHom_of_uvSwapEquiv_fixed`), so the argument can be placed before line 887 or the theorem moved after it. The new proof is `intro x hx; obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := chartHom_surjOn_fixedSubring_noTwo hreg hsep x hx; exact RingHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨f, hf⟩`. In fact, `range_chartHom_eq_fixedSubring_noTwo` (line 1049) already states the stronger equality without `htwo`.
